title: On the three space property for $C(K)$-spaces
summary: Assuming $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak c$, we show that for every Eberlein compact space $L$ of weight $\mathfrak c$ there exists a short exact sequence $0\to c_0\to X\to C(L)\to 0$, where the Banach space $X$ is not isomorphic to a $C(K)$-space.
